text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hm? Are you okay, Sato? Are you tired?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry. I just zoned out a little bit. I'm completely fine…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You went to the trouble of inviting me out, so let's have all the fun we can today!

text_block_list.name: Arcade Employee
text_block_list.text: P-please, stop! I'm begging you! You're going to take this arcade for all it's worth!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: S-Sato! Snap out of it! You've already won all of the prizes! This battle's already over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she doesn't let it show, Satono Diamond's busy race schedule has really tired her out…
